title: The yearly goal review
objectives: Run the five yearly review checks for each goal.
Say when a review happens: yearly and on life events, not on headlines.
body_md:
Progress: is the current value at or above where the plan expected it to be by now? Target: has the goal's cost, date or priority changed? Asset mix: has the mix drifted from the target for this horizon? Glide path: is it time to shift part of the money from equity to debt? Contributions: has the SIP been stepped up as planned? Any missed instalments?

| Check | Question |
| --- | --- |
| Progress | Is the current value at or above where the plan expected it to be by now? |
| Target | Has the goal's cost, date or priority changed? |
| Asset mix | Has the mix drifted from the target for this horizon? |
| Glide path | Is it time to shift part of the money from equity to debt? |
| Contributions | Has the SIP been stepped up as planned? Any missed instalments? |

Don't panic-review. A market fall in a goal that is 10 years away is not a reason to change the plan. The review is yearly, and on life events, not on headlines.
example: Education goal 11 years away, markets fell 15%: the plan already expects falls — review yearly, not on headlines; the SIP keeps buying cheaper units.
say: Review goals once a year and as they approach, not every time the market moves.
A fall in a 10-year goal is not a reason to change the plan.
never: Change a 10-year goal's plan on every market fall.

check.q: When should goals normally be reviewed?
check.why: Yearly and on life events. Not on headlines.
